definitions.explanation: A main location from which operations or activities are conducted; a strategic point.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧{拠点|きょてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{物流|ぶつりゅう}→物流：05137_butsuryuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{拠点|きょてん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This city is a logistics hub.

examples.japanese: ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧{拠点|きょてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}→設立：14171_setsuritsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{拠点|きょてん} means a base, hub, or strategic location from which activities are conducted.

ETYMOLOGY:
- {拠|きょ}: to depend on, base
- ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧: point, location

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧{拠点|きょてん}: activity base, center of operations
- ⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧{拠点|きょてん}: production base
- ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧{拠点|きょてん}: research center
- ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧{拠点|きょてん}: overseas base
- ⟦{物流|ぶつりゅう}→物流：05137_butsuryuu⟧{拠点|きょてん}: logistics hub

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {拠点|きょてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to establish a base
- {拠点|きょてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧: to set up headquarters
- {拠点|きょてん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: as a base

USAGE:
Commonly used in business, military, and organizational contexts. Implies a strategic importance beyond just "location" (⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧).
